answer: An agent marketplace requires every seller to lock a $100 bond for 30 days before bidding, with one concurrent job capped at $100 per bond. Whether agents map a canyon, critique a sonnet, or price walnut lumber, each extra identity needs fresh collateral; splitting one bond creates no extra capacity. A sybil attacker must immobilize $100 per active alias, tying up capital and sacrificing its use elsewhere.
